text:
### Initial Information Collected  
- Account number (source account)
- Payee name (recipient)
- Payee account number (for internal transfers) or sort code + account (for external)
- Amount (fixed, no variations)
- Frequency (weekly, monthly, quarterly, annual)
- Start date (when first payment should occur)
- End date (optional, when standing order should stop)

raw_entities.name: Standing Order Setup
raw_entities.description: The end-to-end process for establishing a standing order payment instruction on a customer account. Captures the collection of source account, payee details, payment amount, frequency, and start/end dates required to initiate recurring payments.
context: Start date (when first payment should occur)
End date (optional, when standing order should stop)

raw_entities.name: Source Account Identification
raw_entities.description: The step in which the source account number from which the standing order payments will be debited is collected and recorded.

raw_entities.name: Payee Details Collection
raw_entities.description: The step in which payee identification information is collected, including payee name and account routing details (either internal account number or external sort code and account number).
context: Payee account number (for internal transfers) or sort code + account (for external)

raw_entities.name: Payment Amount and Frequency Specification
raw_entities.description: The step in which the fixed payment amount and payment frequency (weekly, monthly, quarterly, or annual) are collected and recorded for the standing order.

raw_entities.name: Payment Schedule Definition
raw_entities.description: The step in which the start date for the first payment and optional end date for standing order termination are collected and recorded.
context: Start date (when first payment should occur)
End date (optional, when standing order should stop)

raw_entities.name: Source Account
raw_entities.description: The customer account from which standing order payments will be debited on a recurring basis according to the specified frequency and schedule.

raw_entities.description: A recurring payment instruction established on a customer account with fixed amount, defined frequency, and specified start and optional end dates for automated payments to a named payee.

properties.purpose: Establish a recurring payment instruction from a customer's account to a named payee
properties.trigger: Customer request to set up a standing order
properties.outcome_success: Standing order created with all details captured and validated, ready for first payment on start date

properties.input: Customer identification and account access request

properties.output: Payee name, account number, sort code (if applicable)
properties.failure_path: Request clarification or correction of payee details before proceeding

properties.output: Fixed payment amount and frequency (weekly, monthly, quarterly, or annual)

properties.input: Start date and optional end date
properties.output: Payment schedule with start date and end date (if applicable)

properties.role_in_process: Funding account for standing order payments

properties.setup_or_amendment_process: Collect source account, payee details, fixed amount, frequency (weekly, monthly, quarterly, annual), start date, and optional end date
properties.beneficiary_validation: Payee name and account number (internal) or sort code and account number (external) captured and stored
properties.cancellation_process: Customer may request cancellation at any time; end date may be specified during setup
